name: COUNTBLANK
description: COUNTBLANK counts the number of empty cells within a specified range.
tldr: COUNTBLANK returns the count of completely blank cells in a range.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: The range of cells to check for blank cells.

basicExample.description: Count blank cells in a data range
basicExample.explanation: Counts how many cells in A1:A10 are completely empty.

advancedExamples.title: Calculate completion rate
advancedExamples.description: Determine what percentage of cells have been filled in
advancedExamples.explanation: Subtracts the blank count from the total to get the completion percentage.

howItWorks: COUNTBLANK scans each cell in the range and counts it only if it is completely empty. Cells containing formulas (even those returning empty strings) are not counted as blank.

howToSteps.name: Select output cell
howToSteps.text: Choose where the result should appear.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result shows the number of blank cells.

limitations: Cells with formulas that return "" are not counted as blank.
Cells with only spaces are not counted as blank.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: COUNTBLANK works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Does COUNTBLANK count cells with formulas?
faq.answer: No, even if a formula returns an empty string, the cell is not considered blank.

faq.question: How do I count cells with spaces?
faq.answer: Use COUNTIF with a space pattern: =COUNTIF(range, " ")
